item.title: Access Sacramento: Empowering Democratic Free Speech | Access Sacramento
item.description: Community Media Stations (like Access Sacramento) are a cornerstone of our democratic society, ensuring that every voice has a platform for expression. By providing open channels for citizens to create and share their own content, Access Sac promotes free speech, encourages civic engagement, and fosters community connections.
